definitions.explanation: The state of being prepared for something, or the measures taken in advance to deal with a potential situation, especially emergencies or disasters.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}への{備|そな}えが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{万一|まんいち}の{備|そな}えとして{食料|しょくりょう}を{蓄|たくわ}えている。
examples.english: I'm stockpiling food as a precaution for emergencies.

examples.japanese: {日頃|ひごろ}からの{備|そな}えがあったおかげで、{被害|ひがい}を{最小限|さいしょうげん}に{抑|おさ}えることができた。
examples.english: Thanks to everyday preparedness, we were able to keep the damage to a minimum.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {備|そな}える (to prepare). Most commonly used in the context of disaster preparedness and emergency planning. The proverb {備|そな}えあれば{憂|うれ}いなし means "preparedness averts danger" (lit. "if there is preparation, there is no worry").

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜への{備|そな}え — preparation for ~
・{万一|まんいち}の{備|そな}え — precaution against emergencies
・{備|そな}えあれば{憂|うれ}いなし — preparedness averts danger (proverb)
・{日頃|ひごろ}の{備|そな}え — everyday preparedness
